## The essentials route {#essentials}

Follow twelve decisions in order. Each lesson includes a worked example and links to its neighbors. The chapter numbers refer to the full curriculum below.

| Stage | Lessons in reading order |
| --- | --- |
| Read a market | [1. Interpret a price move](chapters/market-prices.html) · [2. Estimate the demand response](chapters/demand-elasticity.html) |
| Value a payment | [5. Appraise a project](chapters/project-appraisal.html) · [6. Price insurance](chapters/risk-insurance.html) · [7. Compare state-contingent claims](chapters/state-prices.html) |
| Work with private information | [12. Screen borrowers](chapters/adverse-selection.html) · [15. Quote the next trade](chapters/dealer-pricing.html) |
| Stress-test a balance sheet | [17. Meet deposit withdrawals](chapters/bank-liquidity.html) · [21. Measure purchasing power](chapters/real-returns.html) |
| Trace a macro shock | [23. Diagnose a fall in shipments](chapters/business-cycle-shocks.html) · [24. Test interest coverage](chapters/policy-transmission.html) · [28. Assess a Hong Kong importer's exposure](chapters/hong-kong-exchange-rate.html) |

**Case seminars.** [Allocate scarce stock in Hong Kong](cases/hktvmall.html) or [choose which borrower to finance during a shutdown](cases/global-shutdown.html).

## Professional reading routes

Linked chapters are available. The remaining chapters and workshops are planned.

| Route | Chapter sequence |
| --- | --- |
| Investment analysis | [5](chapters/project-appraisal.html) → [6](chapters/risk-insurance.html) → [7](chapters/state-prices.html) → 8 → 9 → 10 → 22 → 25 |
| Credit and banking | [12](chapters/adverse-selection.html) → 13 → 14 → [17](chapters/bank-liquidity.html) → [24](chapters/policy-transmission.html) → 25 → 29 |
| Corporate treasury in Hong Kong | 3 → [5](chapters/project-appraisal.html) → 25 → 26 → 27 → [28](chapters/hong-kong-exchange-rate.html) → 29 |
| Markets and fintech | [1](chapters/market-prices.html) → [12](chapters/adverse-selection.html) → [15](chapters/dealer-pricing.html) → 16 → 19 → 20 |
